prs.title: SOURCE-EDGE: genuine prime-2 arithmetic high surplus and exact Schur dual savings
prs.body:
## Operation SOURCE-EDGE: genuine p=2 high-sector surplus, not scalar κ redistribution

**Stacked on draft PR #159 @ `6c3f768de3cca5c494ec46681f8997b28e482608`; non-main, no merges/releases/source mutations.** Frozen signed Weil source Git blob `0cc8510b71d178fc79e8d410a86d8b6014cf9178`; one Gamma_R, both completed poles, contact, original half-density, and only true first-window prime power n=2. No zeta-zero coordinates used. **RH PROVED: NO. S₄ sign OPEN.**

### Source-specific new mathematics
- **ES-01 (classical exact)**: With b=log2>1/2, the original shift T_b partitions I=(-1/2,1/2) into two connected prime edges L,R and an untouched center C. The true compressed symmetric shift has norm exactly 1; its **positive discarded Bessel remainder** is
  `M_b(F)=||F_C||²+||F_R−T_b F_L||²`.
- **ES-02 (paper, source-conditional)**: Retain that arithmetic surplus in the original real-Gamma/Bessel lower theorem, rather than bounding the signed prime term only by `−w₂||F||²`. On the complete genuine Q₄ high carrier,
  `D_odd >= (63/500)K_odd + w₂ M_b(V.) + 2|<V.,cosh>|²`,
  `D_even >= (153/500)K_even + w₂ M_b(V.)`.
  Negative sinh pole remains in even Bessel budget. True omitted Gamma tail is positive and not double-counted. No finite PSD lifted to infinite source.
- **ES-03 (actual source square-root range)**: Certified `log2>5/8` and `w₂>12/25` produce the **all-high rank-two** lower `(12/25)(4 ℓ₀*ℓ₀+768 ℓ₁*ℓ₁)` on fixed center [-1/8,1/8]; the two specific source observables belong to the positive surplus form's square-root range. This does **not** establish original low-residual range membership.
- **ES-04/05 (exact rational primitive polynomials, true source)**: P₅/P₆ whole-prime mismatch is a **polynomial in true log2**, with outward rational source intervals. Conditional strict original source high inequalities `D(P5)>5*(63/500)K55`, `D(P6)>3*(153/500)K66`. Crucially cross-check every coefficient with the repo's independently derived `prime_hinge_integral_polynomial` (double-IBP source normalization).
- **ES-06 (exact high inverse)**: On primitive Hilbert space, the source comparator `B=κ I+w₂(I−A_b)` has three exact eigenvalues κ (symmetric edges), κ+2w₂ (antisymmetric), κ+w₂ (center). Hence the **original Schur residual bound** gains two *positive subtractions* compared to scalar κ⁻¹: center energy with coefficient `w/(κ(κ+w))`, edge phase-mismatch with `w/(κ(κ+2w))`. Polynomial moment-null subspace is not automatically invariant under A_b; the ambient inverse is a valid upper, plus an optional exact finite constraint correction. Genuine original residual g is **not** yet source-evaluated, so S₄ remains OPEN.

### ES-07 — an infinite-dimensional no-uniform-gap theorem (proved)

The genuine first-prime mismatch operator has an infinite-dimensional smooth kernel even after all **four** original high-mode moment constraints. For `b=log2`, choose a smooth left-edge function `φ` and form `F=φ+T_bφ`; the center and the edge mismatch both vanish. Four moment equations on five independent left-edge bumps have a nonzero solution; arbitrarily many bumps give an infinite-dimensional kernel.

Therefore **no** positive uniform scalar constant can be extracted from the prime mismatch alone on the complete high space. The improvement is provably directional, not a disguised scalar spectral gap. The exact finite paired-cell mutation controls are separate from the smooth-paper theorem.

### ES-08 — actual original P₁ low/high residual: strict arithmetic saving (source-conditional, hosted verified)

**This supersedes the earlier "genuine original residual not yet evaluated" statement for the single P₁ column.** SHA-pinned genuine original-source calculations integrate the first 64 Gamma modes analytically across the source-certified central interval `C0=[−1/8,1/8]`, preserve both original poles and contact, and bound the infinite omitted Gamma tail by the source B3 derivative estimate. An **independent original completed mixed-moment** packet subtracts all four polynomial channels to obtain the true `g₁=−Q_{poly<=3}(G P₁)'` center moment.

Exact-head rational proof interval:

```
∫_C0 (Q_{poly<=3}(G P1)') dx
∈ [ -28698904926141/10000000000000000,
    -184987569323/80000000000000 ]
≈ [−0.0028698904926141, −0.0023123446165375].
```

Neither endpoint includes zero, so on the actual original P₁ source column:

```
||g₁|C0||² >= 4 * |∫_C0 g₁|² > 0
true original arithmetic Schur-residual upper saving
  >= 237641672250223673235273482314675789824094097197829345521
     /1767500000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
  ≈ 0.000134450733946.
```

This is a **strict positive improvement over the same scalar κ-Young source residual upper** for a genuine signed-source coupling direction, **not** a proof that the full `4×4 S₄` is PSD. The remaining three low residual columns, their cross-polarizations, and the signed `A₄-L_U` comparison have not been certified using this new operator-valued bound. **S₄ OPEN. RH OPEN.**

### Exact-head validation and files

- **Final tested head:** `eb62620300add80f8b38ebf0f7cd54c2a3c5ae36`.
- [Original prime-2/source two-version CI](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39063171306): **SUCCESS**; 28 focused tests each on Python **3.10** and **3.13**, zero failures. Frozen authentic source `SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED`. Independent prime-hinge coefficient cross-oracle and original P₁ source-alignment/omitted-Gamma tests passed.
- [Complete observational SUCC validation](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39063171131): **SUCCESS**, 5,204 mathematical/epistemic tests per Python version plus separate 41- and 37-test suites and auxiliary guards.
- [Original signed Schur workflow](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39063171218): **SUCCESS**, Python 3.10 and 3.13.
- [Collective observer source replay](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39063171115): **SUCCESS**, Python 3.10 and 3.13.
- Research dossier: `research/2026-10-17/PRIME_TWO_ARITHMETIC_HIGH_SURPLUS.md`, code modules `authentic_prime_surplus.py`, `prime_surplus_dual.py`, `prime_surplus_nullspace.py`, `source_prime_center_alignment.py`, tests and deterministic source probe.
- Source negatives: fake independent composite 6, wrong shift/factor-two, altered parity, forged rational, non-first-window lag, phase-locked kernel, non-source `g`. All work isolated from frozen archival originals.

### Next decisive RH-facing calculation

Compute all four **actual** signed-source low-to-high residuals with the original true Gamma tail, identify their center and edge-mismatch Gram **including off-diagonal terms**, form an outward rational Loewner upper on the **full residual matrix**, and combine it with the independently source-certified signed trial `A₄−L_U`. The present P₁ gain is real but not a four-mode sign result; a true first-window sign would not establish all-radius Weil positivity or RH.

**Research-only draft, stacked on PR #159. Main untouched. Do not merge without maintainer authorization. RH PROVED: NO.**

prs.body:
## Motivation
Close the first mathematically valid part of the gap between integer SUCC/FUCC and Connes' multiplicative adelic scaling: do not conflate A/Q with A/Q^×, the original additive successor with a quotient action, or diagonal prime multiplication with a one-place idèle class.

## New exact results
- COT-01: rational explicit counterexample to descending S to Connes' X=A_Q/Q^×.
- COT-02: source-typed single-place idèle p has norm 1/p versus diagonal p norm 1.
- COT-03: complete rational (including nonunit) finite p-adic fixed-point delta coefficient, with precise depth stabilization and independent brute residue counts.
- COT-04: prove C_p(u)=|u|_p^(1/2)/|1-u|_p is invariant under u↔1/u; orientation symmetry is real, not conjectured.
- COT-05: exact all-place diagonal rational product cancellation ∏_v C_v(u)^2=1.
- COT-06: genuine p^k matches the half-density p^(-k/2) of the arithmetic prime-power Weil weight; primitive length log(p), all other terms remain unverified.
- COT-07: artificial contact c=1 yields a reversed-orientation-invariant negative Gram eigenvalue (-2); explicitly **not** a zeta/Connes counterexample.

## Files
- observational_succ/connes_oriented_scaling.py
- tests/test_connes_oriented_scaling.py (10 groups, positive/negative/source controls)
- research/2026-10-18/CONNES_ORIENTED_LOCAL_TRACE_BRIDGE.md
- docs/CLAIM_SUPPLEMENT_CONNES_ORIENTED_SCALING.md
- .github/workflows/connes-oriented-local-trace.yml (Python 3.10/3.13)

## Verification and honest limits
An isolated local ten-test check passed using strict adapters for two imported upstream source classes. **Integrated CI is separately pending**: do not infer it from the isolated check. The module constructs ONLY off-identity local coefficients, not the canonical principal value, global Connes trace, correct Weil sign, a positive-type distribution, or RH. No nontrivial zero locations used.

**RH PROVED: NO.** Imported local theorems and source papers are credited in the research note. Draft only; do not merge.

### Verified integrated GitHub CI at exact head `9924e7783a5ef3657a48c735b5a730f76a971973`
- [Push focused run #39130813499](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39130813499): **success**, Python 3.10 and Python 3.13, 10 exact tests passed each (20 executions total); compiled module/test and SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED.
- [PR focused run #39130839084](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39130839084): **success** at the same head.
- Full repository suite and unrelated research workflows are **separately in progress** and must not be declared successful prematurely.


## Follow-up: multiplication isometry, orientation and conditionally positive log-Gram

**Research note:** [Multiplicative orientation Gram](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/connes-oriented-local-trace-2026-10-18/research/2026-10-18/MULTIPLICATIVE_ORIENTATION_GRAM.md).
**Code/tests/ledger:** observational_succ/multiplicative_orientation_gram.py, tests/test_multiplicative_orientation_gram.py, docs/CLAIM_SUPPLEMENT_MULTIPLICATIVE_ORIENTATION_GRAM.md.

- Two classical all-finite-set PSD kernels: K_D(m,n)=gcd(m,n)/sqrt(mn), K_A(m,n)=min(m,n)/sqrt(mn). Both respect simultaneous multiplication and have identical vacuum-to-prime-jet and divisor-chain coefficients.
- Their normalized feature families densely span the SAME l2(N), giving two distinct isometric multiplication-semigroup representations sharing the SAME vacuum but with no vacuum-preserving intertwining unitary: the (2,3) orbit Gram differs.
- The log-gcd Gram and centered log K_D give positive sums of squares with log(p) weights, even with signed input coefficients (the latter on the zero-sum subspace). A genuine mechanism for orientation-derived conditional positivity, separate from completed Weil PSD.
- Primitive FUCC increment d_D(p^k,p^(k+1))=log(p), multiplied by K_D(1,p^k)=p^(-k/2), recovers the original von Mangoldt prime-power Weil MAGNITUDE, not the SIGNED completed distribution.
- Topology obstruction: n/(n+1)->1 in real log time, but K_D(n,n+1)->0 instead of 1, while K_A(n,n+1)->1. No naive continuous real-log extension of bare divisor kernel.
- Required hostile probes: cross-prime coupling, actual Gamma/contact/poles, fake composite6, conductor/phase, full test-distribution equality. No RH proof.

**Verified integrated focused CI at exact current head ddb68049f79426597e4b1c417ca424967be11a8b:**
[Push run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39143179908) and [PR run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39143184154) both succeeded.
Each runs Python 3.10 and 3.13: 10 original Connes tests + 11 new exact Gram and negative-type tests = 21 per Python version; SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED.
Full repository CI was pending at this observation and is not represented as green. PR remains draft; do not merge.


### Final math extension: literal multiplication shifts and critical Möbius vacuum

At exact head **ad02bbd592bb68c4219ded469f276b7e2997adba**, MOG-08/MOG-09 add actual prime multiplication V_p on l2(N):
- V_p+V_p* is indefinite (an exact 2×2 compression has eigenvalues +1,-1);
- (I-p^-1/2 V_p)*(I-p^-1/2 V_p) is PSD with negative offdiagonal entries;
- B_P=prod_{p∈P}(I-p^-1/2 V_p) has exact Mobius coefficients mu(d)/sqrt(d), and B_P*B_P is PSD for each finite genuine P;
- ||B_P e1||²=prod_{p∈P}(1+1/p), which diverges as P exhausts primes, so the naive half-density operator product does NOT converge strongly on the cyclic vacuum; scalar-normalized vacua converge weakly to zero, not strongly.
This is a rigorous ordinary-l2 boundary, **not** an RH proof or obstruction to some other completed adelic realization.

**Fresh verified CI on this exact final head:**
[Push run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39143788938) and [PR run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39143794435): **SUCCESS**.
Both Python 3.10 and 3.13 passed 10 original Connes + 13 new arithmetic/multiplicative tests (23 each), including independent squarefree subset/Mobius and actual shift-matrix oracles; historical SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED.
Full repository CI must still be read independently; do not infer success. Draft status retained.

### October 18 continuation: the p+1 projective normalization repairs the global-no-go overstatement

- Arithmetic identity: (1+1/p)=(p+1)/p=#P^1(F_p)/#A^1(F_p). The Bruhat–Tits PGL2(Q_p) tree has p+1 neighbors; one chosen boundary end gives a 1:p orientation split. This is a **model geometry**, NOT identified with Connes GL1 idèles.
- The p affine directions and one infinity direction realize the exact normalized local signed vacuum. Its squared weights are p/(p+1), 1/(p+1). The Möbius **minus sign is extra**: a plus-sign mutation has exactly the same probabilities but different coherent phases.
- Finite tensor-product cylinder states have exact normalized projective marginals and consistent pure-state restrictions. A global quasi-local product-state/GNS completion therefore exists classically. The old ℓ²(N) weak-to-zero result remains true **only in the original representation**, not as a universal obstacle to completion.
- In the product measure, p is included independently with q_p=1/(p+1); infinitely many prime occupancies occur almost surely by Euler prime harmonic divergence + second Borel–Cantelli. The new carrier is not silently identified with ℕ or the completed Weil test space.
- A different **analytic** normalization: for Re(s)>1, Z(s)=prod_p(1+p^-s)=zeta(s)/zeta(2s), and lim_{s→1+}(s-1)Z(s)=6/pi². Gamma_R(1)=1, so the Archimedean Gamma factor is not itself the pole cancellation; the projective boundary point at each finite p is not the Archimedean place.
- Source note expanded: research/2026-10-18/MULTIPLICATIVE_ORIENTATION_GRAM.md (MOG-10); new observational_succ/projective_euler_normalization.py, tests/test_projective_euler_normalization.py, ledger MOG-10..13.
- **Verified integrated focused CI** at exact head 64aa0810d9016c9c6948034d0543424f46db011e: [push run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39150805609) and [PR run](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39150810727) successful on Python 3.10 and 3.13. Each: 10 Connes + 13 Gram + 8 projective = 31 exact tests, provenance verified. Full repository suite remains a separate check.
- **RH PROVED: NO.** No all-place test distribution equality, Connes canonical contact normalization, global positive Weil form, or academic priority claim.

prs.body:
## Operation INFINITE TOWER — complete source-Gamma boundary summation

**Stacked on TBF draft PR #170** at d479e5007cb253facf77b6926547b2d490f21fd4. Research-only, no main merge, archival rewrite, release, or publication. Frozen authentic signed Suzuki source Git blob 0cc8510b71d178fc79e8d410a86d8b6014cf9178. Original genuine prime-2 lag and one real-Gamma tower retained; no nontrivial zeros as input. **S4 OPEN / RH PROVED: NO.**

### Four proved source-specific mathematical results (see exact derivation)
1. **IGC-01 exact infinite sum.** The authentic α_j=(4j+1)/2 yields K∞(s)=e^(-s/2)/(1-e^(-2s)) = 1/(2s)+1/4+O(s). Original finite-window shifted-diagonal singularities cancel, leaving four edge/center Carleman corner interactions.
2. **IGC-02 bounded strong limit.** Although the complete Gamma operator is UNBOUNDED, the finite bounded commutators D_J=[A,Gamma_J] have a strongly convergent bounded, skew L²(I) limit D∞. No unproved unrestricted domain assertion [A,Gamma∞] is made.
3. **IGC-03 sharp NO-GO.** Exact ESSENTIAL operator norm ||D∞||_ess=π/2, and π/2 in each reflection parity. Proof via Mellin–Carleman norm π, two disjoint local corner channels modulo compact, and weakly-null logarithmic plateau witnesses. Consequently ||D∞−D_J||_(L²→L²)≥π/2 for **every finite J**. Independent pure rational corner packets prove a weaker floor ≥3/32 without relying on numerical spectral guesses.
4. **IGC-04 domain-sensitive constructive rescue.** For authentic primitive F,G∈H¹₀(−1/2,1/2), the **same omitted tower** obeys a two-sided source-boundary bilinear estimate decaying O(J^(-3/2)) with an explicit formula from four endpoint-zero Carleman corners plus the genuinely smooth edge-edge pieces. A separate source-uniform fully Fraction majorant is implemented and tested. This does NOT imply a K-relative original high-resolvent or S4 positivity.

### Executed evidence / source scope
- Exact rational stand-alone tests (no data-fitting): original denominator spacing, geometric series via independent direct/closed routes, alternating Taylor interval original exponential shell tests, fake-shell spacing mutation, normalized dyadic L² nonnorm witnesses over J=1..10^6, outward rational H¹ tail budgets and strict source/firewall contracts.
- Original source adapter refuses incorrect frozen SHA, fake composite n=6, missing authentic prime-2 wavefront, altered one-real-Gamma scalar normalization or invalid log2 source range.
- Narrow standalone Lean 4.14 core proof checks authentic level spacing, strict order, collision freedom and finite recursion. It does **not** formalize Carleman functional analysis or assert full RH proof.
- Reproducible source-only script and Python3.10/3.13 + pinned Lean workflow. Focused source CI had passed at predecessor head; final exact-head CI must be checked separately.

### Important refusal to overclaim
The limit D∞ is skew-adjoint: it is a boundary transport observable, **not automatically a positive Weil quadratic form**. Endpoint-zero H¹ control does not uniformly dominate the authentic K=V*V relative high-response on arbitrary high modes. Universal all-radius Weil and the signed first-prime S4 gate remain OPEN.

**Next verdict-changing probe:** source-derived interpolation/relative-form mapping from the H¹ boundary estimate to the real signed four-low high-resolvent R4, retaining prime2 half density, contact and both completed poles.

Full dossier: research/2026-10-18/INFINITE_GAMMA_CARLEMAN_BOUNDARY_THEOREM.md; exact source probe: scripts/infinite_gamma_boundary_probe.py.



### Addendum — IGC-06/07/08: exact entire essential spectral band and no-go for naive K transport

- **IGC-06 (PAPER PROVED):** On each actual even/odd reflection sector, the bounded limiting self-adjoint observable i D∞ has essential spectrum **exactly [-π/2,π/2]**, not just essential norm π/2. Proof: Mellin kernel h(t)=1/[4 cosh(t/2)], Fourier multiplier π/[2 cosh(πτ)], weakly-null logarithmic plane-wave Weyl sequences and compact edge remainders. This is a bounded boundary commutator LIMIT, not an unbounded full-Gamma generator spectrum.
- **IGC-07 (PAPER + EXACT comparison):** For fixed a=1/2 and COMPARISON lag 1/2<b<1, the same band survives irrespective of nonzero edge widths; for b>=1 the compressed shift vanishes and spectrum is {0}. Exact rational dyadic corner lower packets survive even as b→1−. No substitution of comparison b for the original genuine log2 source.
- **IGC-08 (EXACT lawful domain counterexample):** Endpoint-zero H¹ test primitive F_n(x)=max(0,1−n|x|), n>=3, has ||F_n||²=2/(3n), ||F_n'||²=2n, ratio=3n²→∞. Thus the H¹ source-tail estimate does not itself furnish the needed K-relative all-high Schur comparison. Signed S4 / RH still OPEN.
- Separate standard-library Mellin discrete spectral scout explicitly says NUMERICAL ONLY. The Carleman constant is established by the analytic proof, not by the scout. Exact source SHA and primary negative controls unchanged.

## OPERATION TWO-SUCC × GAUSSIAN NORM × K-RELATIVE SCHUR

**Stacked child of research PR #171** at `8c46cca801b57a6381dfac08e41731ca70d38904`, review only. Main unchanged. Frozen original signed Suzuki/Weil source SHA `0cc8510b71d178fc79e8d410a86d8b6014cf9178` unchanged. True prime2, one real Gamma, contact and BOTH poles retained. **RH PROVED: NO; original S4 sign OPEN.**

### What is established

1. **Peano two-step and Gaussian ramification, without conflating operations.** `2=S(S(0))`; `2=N(1+i)=1²+1²`. Multiplication by `1+i` is `[[1,-1],[1,1]]`, satisfying `M^T M=2I`, `det M=2`, `M²=2R90`. Thus `M/sqrt2` is an exact 45-degree form-preserving rotation with half-density squared 1/2. But additive SUCC² is NOT Gaussian multiplication², and the two actions live on distinct carriers. p=3 Gaussian inert yet has genuine rational half-density. The Gaussian match does **not derive** Weil's universal p^(-k/2).

2. **Full Gaussian local Euler discrimination.** The classical `ζ_Q(i)=ζ_Q L(s,χ_-4)` factor gives local logarithmic coefficients `(1+χ_-4(p)^k)log p`. At ramified p=2 the ENTIRE Gaussian norm 2^k jet tape matches ordinary rational p=2 coefficients; at split 5 it doubles, at inert 3 it vanishes at odd exponents and first appears at norm9. Exact Fraction source controls reject fake composite6. Gaussian global Γ, conductor and other finite-place factors are DIFFERENT; no completed Weil identification or L-function zero input. At first-prime analytic radius a=1/2, only n=2 is active even though the full arithmetic 2^k tape exists.

3. **Correct variational space.** The inherited high source inequality is `D4 >= κ K` on derivative L², with `K=V*V`, NOT `D4>=κI` there. On the completed primitive K-Hilbert space the associated form has gap κ and the legitimate a posteriori Schur upper is `R(g) <= 2Re<g,F>-q[F]+κ^-1||g-DF||²`. A genuine full continuum residual norm is mandatory. Exact 2×2 countermodel kills the finite-Galerkin-substitute shortcut.

4. **Original clamped Q4 H² trials and Γ operator tail.** Two Jacobi-weighted polynomial primitives have F=F'=0 at ±1/2 and F' orthogonal to original low P1..P4. Independently exact:
   - odd derivative `F'=240/13(P7-P5)`, `||F||²=640/2431`, `||F''||²=230400/13`;
   - even derivative `F'=112/5(P8-P6)`, `||F||²=56448/230945`, `||F''||²=150528/5`.
   From the **original one-real-Gamma Fourier multiplier**, `||Γ_tail,J F||₂ <= (2/d_J²+16/d_J³)||F''||₂`, `d_J=4J+1`, an O(J^-2) source-valid action tail on this clamped H² domain. Never asserted for arbitrary H¹ or L².

5. **Actual frozen original signed source low/high interface.** New adapter evaluates true `authentic_full_low_entry` with these high basis pairs and all four low modes, retains ORIGINAL Γ/contact/prime2/two poles, propagates exact outward rational intervals and authentic Γ tails. It DOES NOT invent the missing full `||g-D_JF||` source action residual needed for S4.

6. **New genuine 2-dimensional positive HIGH subspace certificate.** At J=8 the original signed source q_J is strictly above `(1/2)||F||²` on each clamped primitive, and opposite parity makes their exact signed cross term zero. The omitted Gamma tower is positive. Therefore the **entire 2D span** satisfies `Q_original_complete(F)>(1/2)||F||²` for all nonzero F in that span, with original SHA-pinned rational intervals. This is *not* a uniform high-space K-gap, source-invariant eigenspace, first-window S4 or RH proof. The rational margin 1/2 is not magically the Weil half-density.

### Evidence and reproducibility

- `observational_succ/clamped_k_residual_bridge.py`, `gaussian_prime_two_density.py`, `gaussian_euler_shell_controls.py` plus 3 hostile test suites.
- `formal/GaussianTwoSuccessor.lean` pinned Lean 4.14; only elementary two-successor, Gaussian norm and double-step identities formalized, not analysis.
- `scripts/gaussian_kresidual_probe.py --source --verify` exercises actual frozen Suzuki matrix and Gaussian half-density source gates.
- Dossier `research/2026-10-18/GAUSSIAN_TWO_SUCC_AND_K_RELATIVE_CLAMPED_SOURCE.md` and scoped claim supplement.
- **Exact-head focused CI SUCCESS**, Python 3.10 and 3.13 and pinned Lean, original provenance and parent real-Gamma controls: https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/39163583644 at `6fb1dba87ed273350a636b14b248fccacfb88934`. Broader full-repo workflow checked separately; not claimed green unless finished.

### Next proof gate

Independently compute the genuine continuum **operator action** `||g_i-Q_E H_J F||₂` on the exact high clamped basis with piecewise exp-polynomial source integration, source-normalized contact/poles, and new Γ-tail bounds; only then use the K-Hilbert a posteriori residual formula to produce a certified original 4x4 Schur upper and test S4. 1. **The SUCC index-at-infinity anomaly.** Literal unilateral S on ℓ²(N) satisfies `[S*,S]=P_1`, trace=1 and Fredholm index=-1. Every compressed finite `S_N` has `[S_N*,S_N]=P_1-P_N`, trace 0. It excludes precisely integers sharing a prime factor with M, and strongly converges to `P_1`. It **never** converges in operator norm; `[S,E_P]` also has an explicit norm-one moving-frontier witness. Changing minus to plus fails idempotence.
4. **Finite-place Haar and half-density from literal arithmetic.** `Tr(P_N E_P P_N)/N` converges to `∏(1-1/p)` with exact error ≤`(2^|P|-1)/N`. Valuation-shell difference of multiplication-range projectors has density `(1-1/p)p^{-k}` with error ≤`1/N`. 5. **A genuine finite-adèle Schwartz–Bruhat test, not merely a numerical analogy.** On `A_f` let
   `Φ_P=∏_{p∈P}1_{Z_p×}·∏_{q∉P}1_{Z_q}=Σ_{d|M} μ(d)1_{d·Zhat}`.
   Each summand is an inherited *actual* Tate `RationalCoset`. For every original positive integer n, `Φ_P(n)=⟨n|E_P|n⟩`. Its normalized additive Haar integral is `φ(M)/M`.
6. **Complete finite Fourier test-space identity.** With the source's self-dual finite Fourier convention, `hatΦ_P(y)=Σ_{d|M} μ(d)/d ·1_{d^{-1}Zhat}(y)`. On the **complete** dual quotient `a/M`, it equals the Ramanujan sum `c_M(a)/M` by three routes: Tate compact-open dual oracle, Möbius divisor formula, CRT product formula. Exact Plancherel:

   Some Fourier values are negative despite positivity of the original sieve. The finite harmonic-analysis transport is lossless **only on this declared Schwartz–Bruhat test class**, not the completed Weil test algebra.
7. **Bidirectional clock RN cocycle, independent of sibling unmerged PR #173.** The true inverse-square memory pushforward `W_L(u)du` is not normalized clock Haar `du/L`. Multiplication by `√(L W_L)` gives a correct unitary change of measure, and original weighted source shifts need cocycle `√(W_L(u-a)/W_L(u))`. Its products telescope (pure gauge), but omitting density makes the naive shift norm² >`2L²/9` across the physical cut.
